laws: GENERIC SITE SHELLS STAY QUARANTINED UNTIL THEY PAY RENT

statuses.LIVE_DONOR: Runnable and worth preserving, but not the current head.
statuses.RECOVER: Known artifact/lineage exists; exact source must be recovered.
statuses.IMPORT: External runnable surface to bring into the repo without redesign.
statuses.QUARANTINE: Likely generic/template drift; retain source but do not surface/promote.
statuses.MERGE_CANDIDATE: Overlaps a current head; compare mechanisms before merging.
